summary: @or-sdk/authorizer preinstall fetches Bun runtime to execute an obfuscated sibling payload
details: package.json declares scripts.preinstall = "node setup.mjs", which runs automatically on npm install. setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime archive from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases, unpacks it to a temporary directory, chmods it executable, and then invokes that freshly fetched runtime to execute math_init.js from inside the package. math_init.js is a ~727KB single-line bundle marked "// @bun @bun-cjs" containing string-array-rotation obfuscation (function WV8StW cycling a ~1000-entry packed constant table n7gIxM) with no readable behavior. This file is not referenced from the SDK's main entry (dist/cjs/index.js) and is only reachable through the preinstall Bun invocation. The package is advertised as an OAuth SDK and has no native build or addon requirement that would justify fetching an alternate language runtime at install time to execute an opaque bundle. The pattern — Node lifecycle hook pulling in an alien runtime specifically to run a hidden obfuscated payload — bypasses scanners that only inspect Node-visible code.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
